name: parlayapi
description: Sports odds tools for personal and internal research. Public discovery works without a key; authenticated data uses your own ParlayAPI account. Also exposes account signup, login-email, checkout-link and saved-book-preference tools; these should only be invoked at the user's request.

uvx-preview.description: Keyless discovery and public previews. Requires uv. Add your own account key later to use authenticated data.

uvx-personal-account.description: Authenticated data for your own ParlayAPI account. Requires uv and your own API key.

PARLAYAPI_KEY.description: Your own ParlayAPI account key. Required only for the personal-account installation option; the recommended preview option does not request a key. Do not share this value.

examples.title: Inspect current access options
examples.description: Read public pricing and coverage information before configuring an account.
examples.prompt: Use ParlayAPI to inspect current pricing and book coverage. Do not create an account, send an email or change preferences.
